conclusion: No blocking defect in requested persistent-input integrity target. Added boundary/resume tests pass without implementation changes.

findings.allowed_output_boundary: Constructor output/runtime logs and reviewer review.json stay allowed. No formal scientific acceptance granted.
findings.constructor_boundary: Expected snapshot stays in controller memory; sources/navigation/request/publication/prompt/schema and repair inputs rehashed before output validation/reviewer invocation. Persistent changes fail attribution before reviewer.
findings.failure_semantics: Runner exceptions may skip after-snapshot comparison but already fail attribution; no false integrity pass.
findings.repair_boundary: Integrated synthetic tests modify repair_request and previous_candidate copy; both fail before reviewer; old prior bytes unchanged.
findings.resume_boundary: Success and integrity-failure receipts return unchanged without repeat constructor/reviewer calls.
findings.reviewer_boundary: Sources, generated output, navigation/request/prompt/structural gate rechecked before accepting review.json. New output files also rejected.

limitations: Snapshot covers file bytes and file membership, not empty-directory membership. No current acceptance artifact depends on empty directories.
Change-then-restore during a role run is not detectable.
No prevention of host access, out-of-workspace edits or race conditions; cannot close T07 OS isolation.
Previously stored receipt trust and external between-invocation changes are outside this bounded snapshot change; no authenticated storage claim.
Injected runners are synthetic, not model behavior or scientific material-quality validation.
scope: Post-run material-role input integrity and receipt resume, not OS isolation or scientific acceptance

tests.scope: Before adding three test methods; includes original integrity tests and other material suites.
After adding three independent methods: repair subcases, success/failure resume, source delete and output add.
